# Real data example

The analysis workflow is to load data, prepare model inputs and call the
appropriate module from `bdynets`. Historical real-data analyses belong in
research scripts, outside the package's `R/` directory.

# Documenting and checking the package

Run these commands explicitly from the repository root. Rendering this document
does not build or overwrite the package. The former litr command is preserved
in `docs/legacy-litr/6real.Rmd.txt`.

```{r document-package, eval=FALSE}
roxygen2::roxygenise("bdynets")
testthat::test_local("bdynets")
```
